title: 多模态大语言模型的统一幻觉模糊测试
summary: 提出系统评估框架，包含细粒度基准UniHall和自适应用例生成SAMF，通过进化策略探索幻觉边界，发现SOTA模型在模糊测试下性能显著下降，并揭示帮助性-幻觉权衡。
summary_en: Proposes a systematic evaluation framework with fine-grained benchmark UniHall and self-adaptive fuzzing SAMF, revealing performance degradation and a helpfulness-hallucination trade-off in MLLMs.
